"Best Sci-fi strategy game on console" isn't saying much.

Strategy pickings are pretty slim on console. Fans of the genre should be on PC.

This game is a good way to test the waters of the genre for newbies, but if you want to get into strategy games, you really need to go PC. That's where all the best ones are at, and they're mostly exclusive to the platform.

One nice thing about that is that you don't need a very powerful PC to run the vast majority of strategy titles. They tend to run pretty well on relatively low spec machines. A lot of the best ones are older as well, meaning they're mostly cheap.

No one is saying give up your console here, but a gamepad is not the best way to play these kinds of games. They are best experienced on a PC for reasons beyond 'PC Master Race vs Console Peasants'. The best strategy titles are there, there are a lot more options for the genre, and the interface and controls are better. Gamepads will never work as well for this style of game because of the nature of the gameplay, not even the PS4's touchpad is enough to fix that issue.

If a PS4 is all you have, this is a good title to check out this style of game with. That's really the only reason to play this type of game on a console though, if you have no other options.
